package repository

import (
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
)

// TaskRepository stores tasks.
type TaskRepository interface {
	Create(ctx Context, task domain.Task) error
	Update(ctx Context, task domain.Task) error
	Delete(ctx Context, taskID string) error
	Get(ctx Context, id string) (*domain.Task, error)
	GetWithFields(ctx Context, id string, f queryfields.Set) (map[string]any, error)
	ListByLesson(ctx Context, lessonID string) ([]domain.Task, error)
	ListByLessonFields(ctx Context, lessonID string, f queryfields.Set, filters filters.TaskFilters, sort *filters.SortOptions) ([]map[string]any, int, error)
}

// TaskTestRepository stores test questions and answer options for test tasks.
type TaskTestRepository interface {
	ReplaceForTask(ctx Context, taskID string, tests []domain.TaskTest) error
	ListByTask(ctx Context, taskID string) ([]domain.TaskTest, error)
}

// TaskFileStorageRepository stores starter file references for tasks.
type TaskFileStorageRepository interface {
	ListByTask(ctx Context, taskID string) ([]domain.TaskFileStorage, error)
	ReplaceForTask(ctx Context, taskID string, items []domain.TaskFileStorage) error
}

// TaskLearningTargetRepository stores ordered opaque curriculum references for tasks.
type TaskLearningTargetRepository interface {
	ListByTask(ctx Context, taskID string) ([]domain.TaskLearningTarget, error)
	ReplaceForTask(ctx Context, taskID string, targets []domain.TaskLearningTarget) error
}

// TaskI18nRepository stores task localizations.
type TaskI18nRepository interface {
	Upsert(ctx Context, entry domain.TaskI18n) error
	ListByTask(ctx Context, taskID string) ([]domain.TaskI18n, error)
}

// CodeStructureTypeRepository stores code structure types.
type CodeStructureTypeRepository interface {
	Create(ctx Context, structureType domain.CodeStructureType) error
	Update(ctx Context, structureType domain.CodeStructureType) error
	Delete(ctx Context, id string) error
	Get(ctx Context, id string) (*domain.CodeStructureType, error)
	GetByID(ctx Context, id string) (*domain.CodeStructureType, error)
	GetByCode(ctx Context, code string) (*domain.CodeStructureType, error)
	List(ctx Context, filter filters.CodeStructureTypeFilters) ([]domain.CodeStructureType, int, error)
}
